name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 9 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 41 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.0 days starting 2025-09-29, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
